results.evidence:
restore/backup-ish paths:
/v1/branches/{branch_id_or_ref}/restore: POST Restore a scheduled branch deletion
/v1/projects/{ref}/restore: GET Lists available restore versions for the given project | POST Restores the given project
/v1/projects/{ref}/restore/cancel: POST Cancels the given project restoration
/v1/projects/{ref}/database/backups: GET Lists all backups
/v1/projects/{ref}/database/backups/restore-pitr: POST Restores a PITR backup for a database
/v1/projects/{ref}/database/backups/restore-point: POST Initiates a creation of a restore point for a database | GET Get restore points for project
/v1/projects/{ref}/database/backups/restore: POST Restores a physical backup for a database
/v1/projects/{ref}/database/backups/schedule: GET Gets the backup schedule for a project | PATCH Updates the backup schedule time for a project
/v1/projects/{ref}/database/backups/undo: POST Initiates an undo to a given restore point
/v2/projects/{ref}/backups/download: POST Download project backup
